newsitem.title: USA: Andersen Worldwide won't split into two parts - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Andersen Worldwide won't split into two parts - WSJ.

text.p: Andersen Worldwide apparently will not cut itself into two parts despite continued tensions between its accounting and consulting operations, The Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
Andersen, the world's largest accounting firm, has been debating for the past year whether to sell or spin off its consulting arm, the faster-growing part of its business, the story says.
But top managers oppose the move and those favoring a breakup haven't been able to muster the two-thirds vote needed among Andersen's partners, the story says.
